**Date of Agreement:** April 23, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** AlphaTec Holdings, Inc. is a Delaware corporation, operating alongside subsidiaries AlphaTec Spine, Inc. (a California corporation) and SafeOp Surgical, Inc. (a Delaware corporation). All three entities serve as joint borrowers under the credit facility.

The transaction involves MidCap Funding IV Trust (a Delaware statutory trust managed by Apollo Capital Management, L.P.) as both Agent and sole Lender. This amendment modifies key terms of the existing revolving credit facility.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment adjusts various facility parameters including reducing the Additional Tranche size, modifying borrowing base calculations for inventory eligibility, increasing permitted investment thresholds, and formalizing the current revolving loan commitment amount.

**Company Background:** N/A - Limited background information provided in the amendment document.

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Established credit relationship** - Amendment to existing facility dating back to September 2022, indicating ongoing lender confidence
• **Secured structure** - Full security interest and liens on collateral maintained and reaffirmed
• **Fee generation** - Transaction generates $125,000 in immediate fees ($50,000 amendment fee + $75,000 additional tranche fee)
• **Borrowing base discipline** - Inventory eligibility capped at lesser of $20M or 50% of revolving loan limit
• **Apollo backing** - Managed by established credit manager Apollo Capital Management

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Reduced additional capacity** - Additional Tranche decreased from $25M to $20M, potentially indicating tighter liquidity needs
• **Limited financial disclosure** - Amendment provides no financial performance metrics or covenant details
• **Concentration risk** - Single lender structure with MidCap Funding IV Trust as 100% provider
• **Industry/operational risks** - N/A (insufficient information provided)

**Mitigating Factors:**
• Maintained security interests and collateral coverage
• Existing borrower representations and warranties confirmed
• No defaults or events of default existing as condition precedent
